newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling falls on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling falls on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling continued a week-long depreciation against the dollar and pound on Friday ahead of economic policy changes expected in the 1997/98 annual budget, financial analysts said on Friday.

The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 625.1850 to the dollar compared to 624.6900 on Thursday. On the pound, the shilling exchanged at a mean rate of 1020.9303 from 1019.8096, the central Bank of Tanzania said.
"Normally, in the period prior to the budget session there is depreciation of the shilling," one senior foreign exchange banker told Reuters. He gave no further details.
The Bank of Tanzania did not actively intervene to shore up the shilling in the past week, he said.
The budget is scheduled for June 19.
"There's a feeling they (BoT) want the shilling to depreciate or perhaps they're broke," he added.
